articles.title: A Dog’s Perfect Christmas review: Netflix kicks off holiday movie season with a whimper
articles.summary: Dennis Quaid is wasted in a predictable drama with a cute basset hound and not much more

articles.title: Tinto Brass, director of Caligula and maestro of Euro erotica, dies aged 93
articles.summary: The cult Italian film-maker began as an assistant to Roberto Rossellini but moved into sex films, believing ‘eroticism to be a fundamental key to human expression’

articles.title: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend review – India’s most expensive film ever becomes spectacular, huge-scale epic
articles.summary: Based on the ancient classical poem about Rama, the avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, this three-hour blockbuster is highly enjoyable

articles.title: Callum Turner emerges as James Bond favourite as Pierce Brosnan endorses actor: ‘He’s so strong’
articles.summary: Bookmakers’ odds have shortened to 8/13 for the British actor, seen sipping martinis with his wife Dua Lipa at the weekend

articles.title: Crawlers review – killer-spiders movie offers giant-arachnid action alongside anticapitalist commentary
articles.summary: A witty creature feature set in a multi-occupancy building in Los Angeles that takes aim at unscrupulous landlords and finance bros

articles.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint review – Dickensian festive Britpic decorated by selection box of familiar faces
articles.summary: A cast including Richard E Grant, Celia Imrie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Nigel Planer warm up a formulaic narrative about a imperilled retirement community

articles.title: Amazing Grace review – blazing Hannah Walters struggles to save a lonely caller at the end of his tether
articles.summary: Daniel P Lewis stars in his own script as an isolated man beset by trauma as a helpline counsellor Walters tries to heal his pain

articles.title: Judi Dench says Daniel Craig ordered her death. James Bond just got a lot scarier
articles.summary: Not only did Craig insist his 007 die at the end of his run, but now we learn from Dench’s memoir that it was his idea to kill her off too. How will the next Bond top that? Shoot a puppy?
